title: Jack Sarfatti and physicists gather at Puharich's house

tellings.quote: just all sorts of Sarfattis, Jack Sarfatti being one of them. Like him and his kind of group of physicist people would go up there.

plain: In the 1970s, the story goes, a house in Ossining, New York, belonging to a man named Puharich became a gathering place for physicists. A researcher who is not named on the show tells Michels that 'all sorts of Sarfattis' went up there, among them the physicist Jack Sarfatti and 'his kind of group of physicist people.' The guest gives no source, and offers it as a picture of the circle of scientists around Puharich's house.
